mapper.select: select s.schedule_id, s.course_class_name, s.grade_name, s.subject_name, s.period_name, s.time_slot, s.teacher_name, c.classroom_name, c.campus_name, (select max(r.class_date) from edu_class_sign_in r where r.schedule_id = s.schedule_id and r.del_flag = '0') as last_sign_date, (select count(*) from edu_class_sign_in r where r.schedule_id = s.schedule_id and r.del_flag = '0' and r.class_date = (select max(r2.class_date) from edu_class_sign_in r2 where r2.schedule_id = s.schedule_id and r2.del_flag = '0')) as total_count, (select sum(r.sign_status in ('1','4','5')) from edu_class_sign_in r where r.schedule_id = s.schedule_id and r.del_flag = '0' and r.class_date = (select max(r2.class_date) from edu_class_sign_in r2 where r2.schedule_id = s.schedule_id and r2.del_flag = '0')) as actual_count, (select max(r.review_status) from edu_class_sign_in r where r.schedule_id = s.schedule_id and r.del_flag = '0' and r.class_date = (select max(r2.class_date) from edu_class_sign_in r2 where r2.schedule_id = s.schedule_id and r2.del_flag = '0')) as review_status from edu_course_schedule s left join edu_classroom c on c.classroom_id = s.classroom_id where s.del_flag = '0' and s.teacher_id = #{teacherId} and (s.status = '0' or exists(select 1 from edu_class_sign_in pending where pending.schedule_id=s.schedule_id and pending.del_flag='0' and pending.review_status='2')) order by s.period_name, s.time_slot, s.schedule_id

select r.schedule_id, r.class_date, max(r.review_status) as review_status, max(r.review_reason) as review_reason, max(r.review_version) as review_version, max(r.review1_admin_id) as review1_admin_id, max(r.review2_admin_id) as review2_admin_id, count(*) as total_count, sum(r.sign_status in ('1','4','5')) as actual_count, c.course_class_name, c.grade_name, c.subject_name, c.period_name, c.time_slot, c.teacher_name, cc.classroom_name, cc.campus_name, (case when max(r.review2_admin_id) is not null then 2 when max(r.review1_admin_id) is not null then 1 else 0 end) as confirmed_count from edu_class_sign_in r join edu_course_schedule c on c.schedule_id = r.schedule_id and c.del_flag = '0' left join edu_classroom cc on cc.classroom_id = c.classroom_id where r.del_flag = '0' and r.class_date = #{classDate} group by r.schedule_id, r.class_date, c.course_class_name, c.grade_name, c.subject_name, c.period_name, c.time_slot, c.teacher_name, cc.classroom_name, cc.campus_name order by r.class_date desc, c.period_name, c.time_slot

select r.sign_in_id, r.schedule_id, r.class_date, r.enrollment_id, r.student_name, r.source_type, r.sign_status, r.review_status, r.review_reason, r.review_history, r.review1_admin_id, r.review1_admin_name, r.review1_images, r.review1_time, r.review2_admin_id, r.review2_admin_name, r.review2_images, r.review2_time, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.remark, c.course_class_name, c.grade_name, c.subject_name, c.period_name, c.time_slot, c.teacher_name, cc.classroom_name, cc.campus_name from edu_class_sign_in r join edu_course_schedule c on c.schedule_id = r.schedule_id left join edu_classroom cc on cc.classroom_id = c.classroom_id where r.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and r.class_date = #{classDate} and r.del_flag = '0' order by r.source_type, r.sign_in_id

select max(r.review_status) as review_status, max(r.review_reason) as review_reason, max(r.review_version) as review_version, max(cast(r.review_history as char)) as review_history, max(r.review1_admin_id) as review1_admin_id, max(r.review1_admin_name) as review1_admin_name, max(r.review1_images) as review1_images, max(r.review1_time) as review1_time, max(r.review2_admin_id) as review2_admin_id, max(r.review2_admin_name) as review2_admin_name, max(r.review2_images) as review2_images, max(r.review2_time) as review2_time, count(*) as total_count, sum(r.sign_status in ('1','4','5')) as actual_count from edu_class_sign_in r where r.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and r.class_date = #{classDate} and r.del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from edu_class_sign_in where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and class_date = #{classDate} and del_flag = '0'

select e.enrollment_id, e.parent_id, e.student_name, e.contact_phone, parent.phonenumber as parent_phone from edu_enrollment e left join sys_user parent on parent.user_id = e.parent_id where e.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and e.enrollment_status in ('1', '报名成功') and e.del_flag = '0' and e.status = '0' order by e.enrollment_id
mapper.delete: delete from edu_class_sign_in where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and class_date = #{classDate}
mapper.insert:
insert into edu_class_sign_in (schedule_id, class_date, enrollment_id, student_name, source_type, sign_status, review_status, create_by, create_time, remark) values
(#{item.scheduleId}, #{item.classDate}, #{item.enrollmentId}, #{item.studentName}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.signStatus}, '0', #{item.createBy}, sysdate(), #{item.remark})
mapper.update: update edu_class_sign_in set review1_admin_id = #{adminId}, review1_admin_name = #{adminName}, review1_images = #{images}, review1_time = sysdate(), review_status = '1', update_by = #{adminName}, update_time = sysdate() where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and class_date = #{classDate} and del_flag = '0' and review1_admin_id is null

update edu_class_sign_in set review_status = '1', review2_admin_id = #{adminId}, review2_admin_name = #{adminName}, review2_images = #{images}, review2_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{adminName}, update_time = sysdate() where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and class_date = #{classDate} and del_flag = '0' and review_status in ('0','2') and review1_admin_id is not null and review2_admin_id is null

update edu_class_sign_in set review2_admin_id = #{adminId}, review2_admin_name = #{adminName}, review2_images = #{images}, review2_time = sysdate(), review_status = '1', update_by = #{adminName}, update_time = sysdate() where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and class_date = #{classDate} and del_flag = '0' and review2_admin_id is null and review1_admin_id is not null and review1_admin_id != #{adminId}

update edu_class_sign_in set review1_images = #{images}, review1_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{adminName}, update_time = sysdate() where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and class_date = #{classDate} and del_flag = '0' and review1_admin_id = #{adminId}

update edu_class_sign_in set review2_images = #{images}, review2_time = sysdate(), update_by = #{adminName}, update_time = sysdate() where schedule_id = #{scheduleId} and class_date = #{classDate} and del_flag = '0' and review2_admin_id = #{adminId}
